punchline: Outside her son's door, ready to hurl an imaginary boulder at his computer, Tara Brach waited, and found fear underneath the rage.
thirty_sec: Tara Brach and her teenage son were at war over a computer game. One evening she stood outside his door, picturing a boulder through his screen. Instead of barging in, she paused and felt the anger as pressure in her chest and a clenched jaw. Under it she found fear that he would fail, then grief. When she finally knocked, she said much what she'd said before, but she could listen. They parted warmly.
